risk_note: RV2 money (apps/api/src/modules/payout/domain/channel-result.ts, infra/channels/**): the channel bill port of R2 (BR-WDR-23, D10-408; Alipay first). PayoutChannel gains billDetails(appId, billDate), returning bill rows with out_biz_no, channel_order_id, amount in fen (bigint passed through), channel status and booking time. FakeChannel serves injected demo bills per (appId, billDate); with no injection it rejects with PayoutBillUnavailableError, and an injected [] is an empty bill. AlipayChannel sends no gateway request and rejects with PAYOUT_BILL_UNAVAILABLE, with TODO(规划/11 §2.3) blocked on the 规划/09 bill-download test and recording; no platform bill format is assumed or forged (hard rule 7). BankCard and Wechat reject with ChannelDisabledError, like transfer and query. No amount arithmetic, no clock, no database change. Rule tests by a fresh independent Claude (approvals #36), red PASS on the spec commit (10 red, 0 problems). Implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run. verify:fast exit 0. Full verify on the test machine (verify/1): exit 124 at the 3600 s limit with no failing case before it; channel-bill and the existing channel suites passed; recorded per D10-319, CI verify-int is the check.
